report:
Left thigh tumour, wide excision

Received in formalin is a wide excision specimen from the left thigh, measuring 150 x 100 x 70 mm. The specimen is oriented (one stitch proximal, two stitches medial). Sectioning shows a myxoid, fleshy tumour measuring 95 x 70 x 50 mm, 8 mm from the closest (deep) margin. Representative sections are taken in 12 blocks.

(1-8) Tumour.
(9) Deep margin.
(10) Proximal margin.
(11) Distal margin.
(12) Medial and lateral margins.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Wide resection
- Tumour site: Trunk and extremities (left thigh)
- Tumour size: 95 x 70 x 50 mm (greatest dimension 95 mm)
- Tumour focality: Unifocal
- Tumour depth: Skeletal muscle, intermuscular

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Myxoid liposarcoma
  - Hypercellular (round cell) areas: 10%
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a myxoid liposarcoma. The tumour is composed of uniform ovoid cells arranged haphazardly in a myxoid stroma containing delicate, thin-walled, branching blood vessels. Hypercellular (round cell) areas account for about 10% of the tumour.
- Histologic grade (FNCLCC grading): Grade 2 (score 4 or 5, high grade)
  - Tumour differentiation: High-grade myxoid (round cell) liposarcoma (score 3)
  - Mitotic rate: 3 mitoses per 10 HPF, 22 mm eyepiece (score 1)
  - Tumour necrosis: Not identified (score 0)
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified

Margins
- Surgical margin: Uninvolved by tumour (closest 8 mm, deep margin)
  - Deep margin: Clear by 8 mm (block 9)
  - Proximal margin: Clear by 30 mm (block 10)
  - Distal margin: Clear by 35 mm (block 11)
  - Medial margin: Clear by 15 mm (block 12)
  - Lateral margin: Clear by 20 mm (block 12)
  - Intact fascial envelope / fibrous pseudocapsule at the closest margin:
    Present

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT2

Additional findings
- Preresection treatment: No known preresection therapy
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Ancillary studies
- DDIT3 / FUS rearrangement (FISH): DDIT3 rearrangement detected

SOFT TISSUE, left thigh tumour, wide excision:
- MYXOID LIPOSARCOMA with 10% hypercellular (round cell) areas,
- FNCLCC Grade 2,
- Resection margins clear.
